key.name: toggle-highbeam
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens and closes the search popup.

key.name: popup-monitor
key.description: Open the popup on the primary monitor, or on the monitor under the mouse pointer.

key.name: max-provider-results
key.description: How many results to show from each GNOME search provider (Files, Settings, Calculator…), and from open windows.

key.name: enable-calculator
key.description: Show the answer when the query is arithmetic, such as 2+2 or sqrt(2). Enter copies it.

key.name: enable-windows
key.description: Search open windows by title and app, on every workspace.

key.name: enable-system-actions
key.description: Include Lock Screen, Log Out, Power Off and similar actions in the application results.

key.name: enable-web-search
key.description: Add a “Search the web for …” result (last, unless result-order says otherwise).

key.name: web-search-url
key.description: Address opened by the web search result. %s is replaced by the query.

key.name: remember-query
key.description: Show the previous query, selected, when the popup opens. Typing replaces it.

key.name: learn-from-selections
key.description: Rank results you picked before higher for the same or a similar query. The history is stored in ~/.local/share/highbeam/history.json.

key.name: forget-history
key.description: Incremented by the preferences' Forget button; HighBeam then clears its history. Not meant to be set by hand.

key.name: result-order
key.description: Order of the result sections: calculator, apps, windows, gnome (GNOME's search providers, in the order set in GNOME Settings) and web. Missing entries are added at the end.

key.name: theme
key.description: Dark, light, or follow the system style (Settings → Appearance).

key.name: results-max-height
key.summary: Maximum height of the result list in pixels

key.name: blur
key.description: Blur whatever is behind the popup. Most visible with a lower background opacity.
